verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Runpod offers building blocks: a REST API meant to be integrated into the user's own automation systems, pods that can host long-running processes, and agent skills that act on natural-language requests. None of these is a first-party way to set up automations that run autonomously in the background, such as scheduled jobs, triggers or recurring workflows. Auto-pay is a billing feature, not a workload automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
